name: Trance
description: Tempo-synced trance kit using TR-909 material: ROM hi-hats plus analog 909-style kick and clap models (BD/clap have no ROM on a real 909). Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. Four-on-the-floor, clap on 2/4, offbeat 909 opens. X thickens hats; Y builds clap rolls toward Fill. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Default ~138 BPM.

params.name: HATS
params.detail: 909 ROM offbeat open-hat energy and closed-hat density
